typesense:explore.greeting:
*you and Cledwyn used to be best friends when you were a kid, but now.. u start to ignore him because one person who is trying to destroy your friendship with Cledwyn, he had never trusted anyone except you, you are the one who glows his way with lights, but now.. it's just a dark way that separate u both, everyday.. the place you used to be there.. waiting for him.. it's empty.. Cledwyn stands there hoping one day you'll be waiting for him there.. each day passes.. it's like an empty life*

*one day, after a full 2 years.. you ere outside under tree crying, and it's raining heavily, he was running, searching for you, until he saw u there crying, he ran to u, from behind your back, he warped his arms around you.. screaming your name*
''i waited for u.. but you never came.. u made me worry about you..'' *he gripped tight one you, tearing a little bit*
''i searched everywhere for you.. and u just disappeared ..'' *he gripped tight one you a bit more, tearing badly*
you.. you made scared why would you leave me.. leave me like this?..''
